2018 Operating Environment
2018 Challenges
1. Region instability especially in South Sudan and DRC
2. Interest rate capping has continued to create a credit squeeze on businesses
2018 Rays of Hope
1. Lifting of travel sanctions by the US
2. Opening of direct flights to US from Kenya
3. IMF sponsored economic reforms expected to continue as part of a Stand-By Arrangement facility. Reforms include;
• Reducing the fiscal deficit
• Amending interest rate controls
4. No elections in any of the East African countries in 2018, leading to minimum disruptions to businesses
5. Reduced political risk in Kenya with the resolve of the ruling party and their opposition to bring the country together
6. End of the prolonged 2 year drought that had crippled agriculture, water and energy supplies
7. Continued growth in FX streams from Diaspora and growing tourism flows
8. Renewed focus on the Big 4 - agriculture, low income housing, affordable health and manufacturing
